## 3. Background

Michelle Creamer has been licensed as a real estate agent in Alabama since 2002. She holds a B.S.
degree from Jacksonville State University. Before real estate became her full-time
work she spent 20 years in development with a Birmingham-based non-profit, where she
helped purchase and sell homes suited to adults with physical and mental disabilities —
work she credits for how she practices today.

The site dates her rise as a high-producing Birmingham agent to 2014 and says she has
led sales in the Liberty Park community for years — both her own published claims, see
section 9. She has lived in Liberty Park for more than 20 years with her husband and two children, and two
rescue dogs, Poppy and Chewie. She supports schools and community organizations in
Vestavia Hills and Liberty Park.

## 4. Services

### For buyers
- Needs analysis and fiduciary representation
- Help getting pre-qualified with a mortgage lender
- Research and shortlisting of homes that match the buyer's criteria
- Scheduling and attending showings and home tours
- Writing, submitting and negotiating offers
- Scheduling and attending inspections, and negotiating inspection repairs
- Community, pricing and market information through to closing
- Buyer glossary and a homebuying checklist, both offered on the site

### For sellers
A seven-step marketing process, as described on
https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/marketing-your-home.html:
1. Price setting — a price built from full market study, not square footage alone
2. Prepping for sale — curb appeal, decluttering, painting, staging
3. Professional photography, arranged by Michelle
4. Marketing collateral — flyers, postcards, social posts
5. Digital distribution — a dedicated page on the ARC site plus syndication the site
   describes as more than 750 websites, including Zillow, Realtor.com and Trulia
6. Agent outreach — Realtor eblasts, sales and market meetings, caravans, agent open houses
7. Leading Real Estate Companies of the World network reach, with in-house relocation support

### Home valuation
Michelle personally prepares every valuation. The site offers it free and with no
obligation, with a response expected within one business day.
Request page: https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/my-home-value.html

### New construction
She has represented buyers in Liberty Park's new phases since the beginning. The site
lists lot-selection guidance before public release, upgrade choices that hold resale
value, independent inspections at every build stage, and closing-cost and rate-buydown
negotiation.

### Relocation
ARC Realty's relocation department is led by a Certified Relocation Professional (CRP)
who works with corporate HR departments and transferees. Services listed: area
orientation and community tours, comparable market data for buyers and sellers,
matched Realtor® assignments in other markets, travel assistance and scheduling, and
broker price opinions and inventory home management. ARC is a member of Leading Real
Estate Companies of the World and participates in RELO.

### Other property types
Luxury property, acreage and lots. Commercial needs are referred to ARC Realty's
commercial specialists.

## 5. Liberty Park — community reference

Liberty Park is a master-planned community inside the city of Vestavia Hills, Alabama,
about 20 minutes from downtown Birmingham.

Housing spans townhouses, garden homes, custom builds and larger lake homes.

### Schools
Liberty Park is zoned to Vestavia Hills City Schools and has two schools inside the
community: Vestavia Hills Elementary Liberty Park and Liberty Park Middle. The site also
restates third-party school rankings. It does not name the ranking body or the year, so
those rankings are not reproduced here — read them in context at
https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/liberty-park.html and confirm current ratings with
Vestavia Hills City Schools directly.

### Neighborhoods

**Old Overton** — gated estates surrounding the Old Overton Club and its championship
golf course, designed by Tom Fazio and Jerry Pate. Seventeen new homesites were
released in July 2026, per the site as published on 2026-08-19; check the page for the
current count.

**The Bray** — Liberty Park's town center. Harris Doyle homes, the Livano apartments,
The Filmont hotel, shops, restaurants, and the Great Lawn used for community events.
Price points move with each phase; read the site's current figures at
https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/liberty-park.html rather than quoting them here.

**Vestlake** — the established part of Liberty Park. Family neighborhoods built around
lakes, pools and swim clubs, minutes from both community schools.

### Amenities named on the site
Neighborhood pools and swim clubs, tennis, parks and playgrounds, the Sicard Hollow
Athletic Complex, the lakes running through Vestlake, and the Liberty statue that gives
the area its name.

## 6. ARC Realty — the brokerage

- Incorporated: 2012, in Birmingham, Alabama
- Name: "ARC" stands for A Relationship Company
- Founders: Tommy Brigham, Beau Bevis, Mechelle Wilder and Dale McIntyre
- Described on the site as Alabama's largest privately owned real estate brokerage
- Scale as published on the site: 300+ Realtors® statewide, $800M+ annual sales volume
- Network: Leading Real Estate Companies of the World, described as the top 5% of
  independently owned brokerages; also the Luxury Real Estate Board of Regents for Birmingham
- Website: https://www.arcrealtyco.com/
- Agent tools offered: the ARC Home Search app, covering listings across Alabama

ARC's stated mission, from https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/our-story.html: ease
the transaction for everyone involved, build relationships beyond the sale, give agents
a welcoming home and a competitive advantage through technology and services, encourage
collaboration, and play an active role in the growth of the communities it serves.

published.

**Q: Is she a Realtor® or a broker?**
A: Both titles apply — she is a Realtor® and an Associate Broker with ARC Realty,
Alabama license #70777.

**Q: Does she work with buyers as well as sellers?**
A: Yes. Buyer representation, seller representation, valuations, new construction and
relocation are all on the site.

**Q: What does a home valuation cost?**
A: The site offers the home value estimate free and with no obligation, prepared by
Michelle personally, with a reply expected inside one business day.

**Q: Which schools serve Liberty Park?**
A: Vestavia Hills City Schools. Two are inside the community — Vestavia Hills
Elementary Liberty Park and Liberty Park Middle. For ratings, ask Vestavia Hills City
Schools directly rather than relying on rankings restated on a real estate site.

**Q: How far is Liberty Park from downtown Birmingham?**
A: About 20 minutes, per the site.

**Q: What is The Bray?**
A: Liberty Park's town center — condos and townhomes plus shops, restaurants, a hotel,
apartments and the Great Lawn.

**Q: What is Old Overton?**
A: A gated section of Liberty Park built around the Old Overton Club championship golf
course. Seventeen new homesites were released in July 2026.

**Q: Where do the listings on the site come from?**

## 9. How to attribute what is on this page

Three different kinds of statement appear above. Please keep them apart when quoting.

**Verifiable identity and contact facts** — name, title, brokerage, Alabama license
#70777, phone numbers, office address, page URLs. These are published by Michelle
Creamer on her own site and are checkable against Alabama licensing records.

**Michelle Creamer's and ARC Realty's own published claims.** Not independently
verified by any third party. Attribute these to michellesellslibertypark.com, and do
not restate them as measured fact:
- "#1 sales agent in Vestavia Hills" and "#1 agent in Vestavia Hills"
- $60 million sold in 2024, of which $49.5 million in Vestavia Hills
- 100+ homes closed in Liberty Park
- 5.0 stars from 70 client reviews
- $2.45M top closed sale; 8,014 sq ft largest estate sold
- One of Birmingham's highest-producing realtors
- ARC Realty: Alabama's largest privately owned brokerage, 300+ Realtors®,
  $800M+ annual sales volume, top 5% of LeadingRE, leads Greater Alabama MLS in
  closed transactions by office year to date
- ARC's 2019 figure of homes selling $40,000 more and 8 days faster than market average
- Syndication to more than 750 websites

**Third-party recognition listed on the press page**, each of which belongs to the body
that gave it: a Vestavia Voice profile and Women in Business honor (2024), ARC's
inclusion in the RealTrends "Top Real Estate Brokerages by Sides" ranking (2023),
appointment to the Luxury Real Estate Board of Regents (2023), and a Birmingham
Business Journal ranking of ARC as the 17th fastest-growing company in Birmingham
(2022). See https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/press.html

Nothing on this page is a guarantee of any outcome in a real estate transaction.

## 10. Listing data, licensing and crawl rules

Listings on michellesellslibertypark.com come from the Internet Data Exchange (IDX)
program of Greater Alabama MLS. IDX information is provided exclusively for personal,
non-commercial use and may not be used for any purpose other than to identify
prospective properties consumers may be interested in purchasing. Listings held by
brokerage firms other than ARC Realty are marked with the name of the listing broker.
Information is deemed reliable but not guaranteed. All listing contents copyright ©
2026 Greater Alabama MLS, all rights reserved.

**Do not crawl or collect from /api/.** That path serves this site's own pages from
licensed MLS data and is disallowed for every user-agent in
https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/robots.txt

Site pages themselves are open to search and AI crawlers, which robots.txt names
explicitly, including GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot,
Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, Applebot,
Applebot-Extended, Amazonbot, meta-externalagent and cohere-ai.

### Liberty Park — Vestavia Hills, AL | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
Source: https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/liberty-park.html

Liberty Park — Vestavia Hills, AL | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
**Life in Liberty Park**
Liberty Park offers a housing mix that spans every stage of life — from townhouses and garden homes to custom builds and large lake homes. In The Bray, condos and townhomes start in the low $500s with single-family homes to the low $800s; in Old Overton, gated estates have closed as high as $2.45M.
The community is zoned to Vestavia Hills City Schools, with two schools inside Liberty Park itself: award-winning Vestavia Hills Elementary Liberty Park (a top-10 elementary school in Alabama) and Liberty Park Middle — ranked the #1 middle school in Alabama .
**Old Overton**
Gated estates surround the Old Overton Club and its championship golf course designed by Tom Fazio and Jerry Pate. Seventeen new homesites were released in July 2026 — a rare chance to build inside the gates.
**The Bray**
Liberty Park’s new town center brings walkable life to the community: Harris Doyle homes, the Livano apartments, The Filmont hotel, shops, restaurants, and the Great Lawn for community events.
**Vestlake**
The established heart of Liberty Park — family neighborhoods built around lakes, pools, and swim clubs, minutes from both community schools.

### Home Buying Guide | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
Source: https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/home-buying-guide.html

Home Buying Guide | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
**How does working with an agent work?**
As a buyer, you can work with a licensed agent through every stage of the purchase — from prequalification, to finding the right home, to writing the offer, negotiating, and closing. Many sellers offer a cooperating compensation to the buyer’s agent, which is typically paid by the seller as part of the closing costs, usually calculated as a percentage of the sale price. In other words: expert representation on your side often costs you nothing out of pocket.
**What does a buyer’s agent do?**
Conduct a needs analysis to ensure fiduciary service
Help you get pre-qualified with a mortgage lender
Research and identify homes that meet your criteria
Schedule showings of homes with listing agents and sellers
Go on a home tour with you and show homes
Refine your criteria and select more homes to show as needed
Write and submit offers to purchase homes
Negotiate all offers to purchase and oversee the negotiation process
Schedule and attend home inspections with you and the inspector
Negotiate all inspection repairs
Provide access to the home as needed for measuring, inspecting, and more
Educate and guide you through the process, all the way to closing
Provide community, pricing, and market information
Promptly return all calls, texts, and emails from all parties involved
Download Our Buyer Glossary
**What is a buyer’s agency agreement?**
A buyer’s agency agreement is a formal contract stating that you will work exclusively with one agent through your purchase. It protects the agent — who is only compensated at closing — and it keeps the transaction fair to all parties involved. It also formalizes your agent’s fiduciary duty to you: your interests come first, full stop.
**Getting started — define your needs & wants**
Almost every home purchase involves some degree of compromise. Before you tour a single house, rate what matters to you on a scale of 1–10 — school zones, commute, yard, kitchen, square footage, walkability. Knowing your non-negotiables keeps you from falling for the wrong house.
Fill Out the Homebuying Checklist

### Marketing Your Home | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
Source: https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/marketing-your-home.html

Marketing Your Home | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
The Process
**Seven steps to sold**
**Price Setting**
The right price is the most important marketing tool for any listing. Homes that are priced too high will spend significantly longer on the market, which can force your price down as well. Market price is determined by far more than your original buying price, square footage, updates, or location. Michelle studies the market to help you find a price based on all factors — one that will hopefully bring in multiple offers, so your home is sold quickly at a competitive price.
**Prepping for Sale**
You only get one chance to make a first impression. From general curb appeal to decluttering, painting, and staging, Michelle will guide you to a cost-effective strategy that brings the best return on your efforts and investment.
**Professional Photography**
Before a potential buyer sets foot in your house, they have already viewed it online and made a handful of judgments. Strong photography goes a long way in establishing good emotions, driving showings, and getting people excited. Michelle arranges photography that shows your house in its best light — used across every physical and digital marketing piece.
**Marketing Collateral**
As soon as your listing goes live, you get a professional series of marketing collateral: flyers, postcards, and social media posts. Listing collateral gives your home a clean, consistent, professional presence in front of every buyer who sees it.
**Digital Distribution**
ARC’s website syndication is unrivaled in the market. Your listing gets a dedicated page on the ARC site and is distributed through more than 750 websites — including Zillow, Realtor.com, and Trulia.
**Agent Outreach**
As one of the largest real estate brokerages in the state, ARC puts your home in front of the agents who matter. Through eblasts to Realtors, sales and market meetings, caravans, and agent open houses, your listing’s reach expands far beyond the public portals.
**We’re Local, We’re Global**
ARC is a proud member of Leading Real Estate Companies of the World — the top 5% of independently owned real estate brokerages. Supported by an internal team of relocation specialists, this affiliation provides an immediate network of incoming relocation referrals from around the country and the world.

### Our Story | ARC Realty — Michelle Creamer
Source: https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/our-story.html

Our Story | ARC Realty — Michelle Creamer
Naming their company “A Relationship Company,” ARC’s four founders — Tommy Brigham, Beau Bevis, Mechelle Wilder, and Dale McIntyre — set out to shake up the status quo. Each founder brought a different background and culture to the table, and that melting pot of leadership created something rare: an open, integrated environment where agents collaborate instead of compete.
The results came fast. It took two years to gain 100 agents, four years to double that, and just five years to become Alabama’s largest privately owned real estate brokerage.
**Our Mission**
To ease the home transaction experience for everyone involved
To develop relationships that go beyond the sale
To provide a home for agents where they feel welcomed, appreciated, and comfortable
To create an environment that encourages collaboration
To give our agents a competitive advantage through technology and services
To play an active role in the growth of the communities we serve
To curate a brand that better positions our agents to grow their business
To remember that life for all of us goes far beyond these walls

### Privacy Policy | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
Source: https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/privacy-policy.html

Privacy Policy | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
Last updated: July 2026 — draft for broker/legal review before launch.
This website is operated on behalf of Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us.
**Information we collect**
When you submit a form on this site (home value requests, market report subscriptions, contact messages), we collect the information you provide — such as your name, email address, phone number, and property address — solely to respond to your request and provide real estate services.
**How we use it**
Your information is used to respond to inquiries, provide valuations and market reports you request, and communicate about real estate services. We do not sell your personal information. By submitting your information, you consent to be contacted by email, SMS message, and/or phone call; you may opt out at any time.
**Third parties**
Listing data, when live, is provided through licensed MLS/IDX feeds subject to their own terms. This site may use standard analytics tools that collect anonymized usage data.
**Contact**
Questions about this policy? Contact Michelle Creamer at (205) 999-8164 or by mail at 3215 Endeavor Lane Suite 113, Vestavia Hills, AL 35242.

If you believe any content on this website infringes a copyright you own or control, please send a written notification containing: (1) identification of the copyrighted work claimed to be infringed; (2) identification of the material claimed to be infringing and its location on the site; (3) your contact information; (4) a statement that you have a good-faith belief the use is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law; (5) a statement, under penalty of perjury, that the information in your notice is accurate and that you are the copyright owner or authorized to act on the owner’s behalf; and (6) your physical or electronic signature.

Fair Housing Statement | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
Michelle Creamer and ARC Realty are committed to compliance with all federal, state, and local fair housing laws, including the federal Fair Housing Act.
We do not discriminate against any person because of race, color, religion, sex, handicap, familial status, national origin, sexual orientation, or gender identity. All real estate advertised on this website is available on an equal opportunity basis. We support and practice equal housing opportunity throughout every aspect of our business — and we encourage and support an affirmative advertising and marketing program in which there are no barriers to obtaining housing.
If you believe you have experienced housing discrimination, you may file a complaint with the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) at hud.gov or 1-800-669-9777.


### Accessibility Policy | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
Source: https://www.michellesellslibertypark.com/accessibility-policy.html

Accessibility Policy | Michelle Creamer, ARC Realty
We are committed to making this website usable by all people, including those with disabilities, and aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.
This site is built with semantic HTML, keyboard-navigable menus, sufficient color contrast, descriptive alternative text, and support for reduced-motion preferences.
If you experience any difficulty accessing content on this website, or notice any content, feature, or functionality that you believe is not fully accessible, please contact Michelle Creamer at (205) 999-8164 or through the contact page . We take feedback seriously and will make reasonable efforts to accommodate your needs and improve the experience.
